title: B0309: unlayered style rules in tokens.cssbrain are reported
why: A rule outside any @layer in tokens.cssbrain silently beats every component rule; the new warning shows where and how to wrap it.
changelog: B0309 (warning): a style rule outside any `@layer`
steps: Wrap each reported rule of tokens.cssbrain in `@layer reset { … }`; custom properties stay unlayered.
